SELECT loan_id, as_of_date
FROM risk_classification
WHERE grade_code = '次级'
ORDER BY loan_id ASC;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE payment_type = '现金支取'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT pp.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM person_profile pp
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.operating_status
FROM customer c
WHERE c.region_code = (
    SELECT region_code
    FROM organization_unit
    WHERE unit_name = '上海分行'
)
ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    is2.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS 合同金额合计
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector is2 ON op.industry_code = is2.sector_code
WHERE op.organization_kind = 'corporate'  -- 对公客户
GROUP BY is2.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.converted_amount) AS total_holding_value
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_holding_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.net_capital AS 资本净额,
       cs.risk_weighted_assets AS 风险加权资产
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(b.ledger_balance) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot b ON a.account_id = b.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND b.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM account_balance_snapshot WHERE account_id = a.account_id)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM institution i
JOIN organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON ou.org_unit_id = sm.home_org_unit_id
JOIN service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON so.operator_id = pe.operator_id
JOIN loan_cashflow lc ON pe.payment_id = lc.payment_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_to_capital_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
  AND cs.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot 
      WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
  )
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY exposure_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    isec.sector_name_zh AS 行业名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 不良笔数,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN ld.loan_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 4) AS 不良笔数占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    AND rc.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM risk_classification rc2 WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id)
GROUP BY isec.sector_code, isec.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 不良笔数占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) AS 在保余额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = '有效'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 在保余额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
GROUP BY pr.source_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(dse.record_id) AS record_count,
       SUM(dse.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN institution i ON dse.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ds.principal_overdue_days AS 逾期天数,
    cg.grade_name AS 分类名称,
    rc.as_of_date AS 分类日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name IN ('正常', '关注')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p.display_name AS 收款方名称,
    isec.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
  AND pi.status = '已执行'
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN op.industry_code IN (SELECT sector_code FROM industry_sector WHERE risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')) THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 违规流入金额,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS 指令金额合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN op.industry_code IN (SELECT sector_code FROM industry_sector WHERE risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')) THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 4) AS 占比
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS 担保笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款协议笔数
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.commitment_id IS NOT NULL 
  AND ca.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 担保笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    p.business_date AS 业务日期,
    pt.name_zh AS 交易类型中文名称,
    p.amount AS 金额,
    ou.unit_name AS 经办机构单元名称
FROM payment_event p
JOIN payment_type_catalog pt ON p.payment_type = pt.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
  AND p.status = '已清算'
ORDER BY p.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    is1.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    is2.sector_name_zh AS agreement_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector is1 ON op.industry_code = is1.sector_code
LEFT JOIN industry_sector is2 ON ca.target_industry_code = is2.sector_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pe.business_date AS 业务日期,
    pe.amount AS 金额,
    ah_from.party_id AS 付款方客户编号,
    ah_to.party_id AS 收款方客户编号
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from 
    ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
    AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    AND ah_from.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN account_holder ah_to 
    ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
    AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    AND ah_to.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id
    AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
    AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    AND pr.effective_from <= pe.business_date
    AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
WHERE pe.status = 'COMPLETED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY COUNT(ld.loan_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account a ON p.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id AS employee_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id AS 台账记录编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cdd.event_date AS 事项发生日期,
    cdd.deadline_date AS 法定截止日期,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS 距截止日的天数差
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cdd.completion_date IS NULL
  AND cdd.deadline_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 距截止日的天数差 DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
       ca.status AS 抵押物状态,
       sa.status AS 担保合同状态
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'released'
  AND sa.status = 'active'
ORDER BY sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = '核销'
  AND sa.status = '有效'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC) AS balance_rank
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    is2.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 本金余额,
    rn AS 排名
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        op.industry_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY op.industry_code 
            ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'  -- 假设状态为ACTIVE表示未结清
) ld
JOIN industry_sector is2 ON ld.industry_code = is2.sector_code
WHERE ld.rn <= 3
ORDER BY is2.sector_name_zh ASC, ld.rn ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_count,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS change_from_previous
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance,
    avg_bal.avg_balance,
    ld.disbursed_amount - avg_bal.avg_balance AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, AVG(ld.disbursed_amount) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount > avg_bal.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS 担保人数量
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on), 0) <= 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN COALESCE(julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on), 0) <= 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN COALESCE(julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on), 0) <= 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN COALESCE(julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on), 0) <= 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN COALESCE(julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on), 0) <= 360 THEN '181-360天'
        ELSE '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY 
    CASE overdue_interval
        WHEN '未逾期' THEN 0
        WHEN '1-30天' THEN 1
        WHEN '31-90天' THEN 2
        WHEN '91-180天' THEN 3
        WHEN '181-360天' THEN 4
        WHEN '360天以上' THEN 5
    END;

SELECT collateral_id, evaluated_on, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, evaluated_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_principal_balance,
    AVG(ld.disbursed_amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
GROUP BY p.party_id
ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id AND sa.effective_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id IN (
    SELECT so.operator_id FROM service_operator so WHERE so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
) AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count,
    AVG(pp.annual_income) AS avg_annual_income,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id)) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND p.customer_segment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount END), 0) AS related_party_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_amount,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount END), 0) * 1.0 / SUM(p.amount), 6)
    END AS related_party_ratio
FROM payment_event p
LEFT JOIN account from_acc ON p.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN account to_acc ON p.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = COALESCE(from_acc.institution_id, to_acc.institution_id)
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = p.from_account_id 
    AND ah_from.effective_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = p.to_account_id 
    AND ah_to.effective_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id 
    AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
    AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= p.business_date)
    AND pr.effective_from <= p.business_date
WHERE p.status = '成功'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_party_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS 持有贷记卡数量,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS 定期存款账户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id AND pc.card_type = '贷记卡'
LEFT JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = '定期存款'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY 
    quartile_group ASC,
    principal_balance DESC,
    loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

SELECT
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance,
    SUM(SUM(lbs.principal_balance)) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lbs.principal_balance) DESC) * 1.0 / SUM(SUM(lbs.principal_balance)) OVER () AS cumulative_ratio
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
GROUP BY i.sector_code, i.sector_name_zh
HAVING cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE l.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(l.loan_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 担保合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    cv.valuation_amount AS 最新评估价值
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN collateral_link cl ON so.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cl.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_amount > 2 * ca.contract_amount
  AND cv.valid_until IS NULL
  AND cv.valued_on = (
      SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
      FROM collateral_valuation cv2
      WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
  )
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - ca.contract_amount) DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS customer_id,
       p.display_name AS customer_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND a.institution_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 1
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id, business_date AS transaction_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS member_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0) AS total_loan_balance
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
LEFT JOIN account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.party_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE egm.exposure_member_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) AS 担保合同数量,
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) AS 担保金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) > 1
   AND SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.payment_mode = '受托支付'
)
WHERE ld.status = '有效'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    li.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方名称
FROM loan_drawdown li
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON li.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON li.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
WHERE p.status = '冻结'
  AND ca.status = '生效'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ca.product_name AS 产品中文名称,
    isec.sector_name_zh AS 投向行业,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON ca.target_industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE ca.product_family = '流动资金类'
  AND isec.risk_category = '退出类'
  AND ld.status = '正常'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    avg_balance.avg_balance,
    ld.disbursed_amount - avg_balance.avg_balance AS difference
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, AVG(ld.disbursed_amount) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_balance ON ca.institution_id = avg_balance.institution_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount > 2 * avg_balance.avg_balance
ORDER BY difference DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM party_relation pr 
        WHERE pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id 
          AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_amount,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM party_relation pr 
        WHERE pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id 
          AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0), 4) AS ratio
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    (SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital, as_of_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM capital_snapshot
) cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.rn = 1
WHERE ld.closed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id, i.institution_name, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING (SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 执行年利率,
    avg_rate.avg_industry_rate AS 所属目标行业平均利率,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_industry_rate) * 100.0 / avg_rate.avg_industry_rate, 2) AS 上浮百分比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_industry_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
) avg_rate ON ca.target_industry_code = avg_rate.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate > avg_rate.avg_industry_rate * 1.1
ORDER BY 上浮百分比 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE op.organization_kind = 'corporate'  -- 对公客户
  AND ld.status = 'active'
  AND abs.ledger_balance > cs.net_capital * 0.10
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY over_limit_customer_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 余额合计,
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE eg.group_type = '集团客户'
  AND cs.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot 
      WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
  )
  AND ld.status = '正常'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.maturity_on AS 合同到期日,
    ld.loan_id AS 未结清借据编号,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = '已到期'
  AND ld.status = '正常'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.loan_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    pe.payment_id AS 转账流水号,
    pe.business_date AS 转账日期,
    pe.amount AS 转账金额,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS 放款至转出的间隔天数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.loan_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'settled'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY 
    放款至转出的间隔天数 ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.borrower_party_id,
        lb.total_principal * 1.0 / c.net_capital AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.institution_id ORDER BY lb.total_principal * 1.0 / c.net_capital DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balances lb
    JOIN capital c ON lb.institution_id = c.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON lb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE c.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    r.ratio
FROM ranked r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON r.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
FROM loan_balance_snapshot
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 机构名称,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ou.org_unit_id) * 100, 2) AS 占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
ORDER BY ou.unit_name ASC, 占比 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 累计放款金额,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = '逾期' THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 逾期本金合计,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = '逾期' THEN 1 END) AS 逾期期次数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN asset_resolution_event pe ON ld.loan_id = pe.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = '正常'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = '逾期' THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 逾期期次数 DESC, 逾期本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    l.loan_account_id AS 放款账户编号,
    l.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    COUNT(*) AS 放款借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown l
GROUP BY l.loan_account_id, l.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id AS customer_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = ah.party_id
ORDER BY customer_id ASC;

SELECT sm.person_party_id AS 员工客户编号
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = '在职'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = '储蓄'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
      AND pe.is_cash = 1
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY 
    CASE bucket 
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1 
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2 
        ELSE 3 
    END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.status = '有效'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY link_count DESC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_type,
    AVG(c.valuation_amount) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.valuation_source = 'internal'
GROUP BY c.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ra.account_id AS 还款账户编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    cnt.cnt AS 该账户承接借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account ra ON ld.repayment_account_id = ra.account_id
JOIN (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
) cnt ON ld.repayment_account_id = cnt.repayment_account_id
WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.loan_id IN (
      SELECT loan_id
      FROM (
          SELECT 
              loan_id,
              repayment_account_id,
              disbursed_on,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on, loan_id) AS rn
          FROM loan_drawdown
          WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
      ) ranked
      WHERE rn <= 2
  )
ORDER BY ra.account_id ASC, ld.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 累计放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    SUM(a.ledger_balance - a.available_balance) AS total_difference
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = '正常'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC, card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = '受托支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_entrusted_payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode != '受托支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_self_payment,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = '受托支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 4) AS entrusted_payment_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING entrusted_payment_ratio < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_payment_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) * 100, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 0.9
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS actual_raise_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 借款人编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 逾期借据笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 全部借据笔数
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'organization'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status != '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY 逾期借据笔数 DESC, 借款人编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    borrower.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    payee.display_name AS 实际收款人名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.signed_on AS 合同签署日期,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 未结清期次数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON l.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE l.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT rs2.loan_id
    FROM repayment_schedule rs2
    WHERE rs2.status = '已结清'
)
GROUP BY l.loan_id
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ab.ledger_balance, 0), 2) AS 期末剩余本金,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ab.debit_balance, 0), 2) AS 期末逾期本金
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN account a ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
WHERE ld.status = '核销'
  AND COALESCE(ab.ledger_balance, 0) > 10000000
ORDER BY ab.ledger_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.opened_on AS 账户开立日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.account_subtype AS 账户类型,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = '储蓄'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = '信用'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH related_parties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type != '非关联方'
      AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= date('now'))
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT target_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type != '非关联方'
      AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= date('now'))
),
avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        product_family,
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY institution_id, product_family, target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 合同年利率,
    ar.avg_rate AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
    (ar.avg_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate) AS 利率价差
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN related_parties rp ON ca.borrower_party_id = rp.party_id
JOIN avg_rates ar ON ca.institution_id = ar.institution_id 
    AND ca.product_family = ar.product_family 
    AND COALESCE(ca.target_industry_code, '') = COALESCE(ar.target_industry_code, '')
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < ar.avg_rate
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS 甲方编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 乙方编号,
    pr.relation_type AS 关联关系名称
FROM party_relation pr
WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
  AND pr.source_party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
  AND pr.target_party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
ORDER BY pr.relation_type ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.net_capital AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id
  AND egm.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
   AND SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN party payer ON ah_from.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN party payee ON ah_to.party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pe.status = 'completed'
  AND pe.is_cash = 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id
        AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id
        AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
        AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
  )
GROUP BY payer.party_id, payee.party_id, payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND wp.status = '在售'
  AND phs.investment_path = '多层嵌套'
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT h.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM wealth_product p
JOIN product_holding_snapshot h ON p.product_id = h.product_id
WHERE h.investment_path = 'multi_layer'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 账面本金余额,
    MAX(rc.overdue_days) AS 最长逾期天数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        MAX(overdue_days) AS overdue_days
    FROM loan_overdue_snapshot
    WHERE overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY loan_id
) rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount > 90000000
  AND rc.overdue_days >= 200
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount
ORDER BY 最长逾期天数 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count, COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(pe.amount)
        FROM payment_event pe
        WHERE pe.to_account_id = ld.repayment_account_id
          AND pe.business_date <= '2025-01-01'
    ), 0)), 0) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ld.exception_flag = 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
      WHERE abs.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
        AND abs.debit_balance > 0
  )
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY overdue_principal_total DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS 对外担保合计,
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0) AS 自身借款合计,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    sm.staff_id AS 员工编号,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sm.departed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id AS 员工姓名,
    sm.person_party_id AS 操作员编号,
    sm.employment_type AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON sm.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE sa.role_code = '信贷经办员'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, sm.person_party_id, sm.employment_type
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'OWNER'
  AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pe.status = '逾期' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 逾期期数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pe.status = '逾期' THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_code
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pe.status = '逾期'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > julianday('2026-06-30') + 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_days_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE a.org_unit_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.org_unit_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(ab.overdue_principal, 0)) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        as_of_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN balance_type = 'overdue_principal' THEN balance_amount END) AS overdue_principal
    FROM account_balance_snapshot
    WHERE balance_type = 'overdue_principal'
    GROUP BY account_id, as_of_date
) ab ON ld.loan_account_id = ab.account_id
WHERE ab.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 逾期期数,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON l.loan_id = pi.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = '逾期'
  AND pi.instruction_date < date('now')
GROUP BY l.loan_id
HAVING SUM(pi.instruction_amount) > 120000000
ORDER BY SUM(pi.instruction_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(rs.interest_due) AS total_interest_due
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
   OR (rs.paid_on IS NULL AND rs.due_date < date('now'))
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 0 OR d.interest_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    lr.loan_id,
    lr.installment_seq,
    lr.principal_due,
    lr.interest_due
FROM loan_repayment_schedule lr
WHERE lr.overdue_flag = 1
  AND lr.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY lr.principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursement_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursement_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc 
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id 
    AND gc.status = '有效'
WHERE sa.security_type = '保证担保'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    cl.credit_line_id,
    cl.credit_limit,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM credit_line cl
JOIN status_catalog sc 
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' 
    AND sc.status_code = cl.status
WHERE cl.is_revolving = 1
ORDER BY cl.credit_limit DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY cf.institution_id, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY total_limit DESC;

SELECT credit_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY credit_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE payment_mode
        WHEN 'CASH' THEN '现金'
        WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN '转账'
        WHEN 'CHECK' THEN '支票'
        WHEN 'BILL' THEN '票据'
        WHEN 'OTHER' THEN '其他'
        ELSE payment_mode
    END AS payment_mode_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY payment_mode
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = '在售'
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        quartile_group,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY quartile_group
)
SELECT 
    quartile_group AS group_no,
    product_count
FROM grouped
WHERE product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC;

SELECT 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
  AND ca.payment_mode = '受托支付'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
LEFT JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = '待执行'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC;

SELECT 
    fi.instrument_type AS 融资工具类型码,
    fi.instrument_type_name AS 融资工具中文名称,
    sc.status_code AS 状态码,
    sc.name_zh AS 状态中文名称
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT instrument_type, instrument_type AS instrument_type_name
    FROM financial_instrument
) fi
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT status_code, name_zh
    FROM status_catalog
    WHERE entity = 'loan_drawdown'
) sc
ORDER BY fi.instrument_type_name, sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    rc.grade_code AS 五级分类名称,
    CAST(julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) AS INTEGER) AS 本金逾期天数,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 逾期本金
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE rc.grade_code = '正常'
  AND julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) > 30
ORDER BY 本金逾期天数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE ps.provision_stage = '2'
  AND ps.required_amount > 0
  AND (ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount) < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS provision_gap_total
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY provision_gap_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, b.ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot b ON a.account_id = b.account_id
WHERE a.status = '久悬'
  AND a.account_kind = '储蓄'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.account_id = a.account_id
        AND ah.holder_role = '次要'
  )
ORDER BY b.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(*) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
  AND p.customer_segment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 客户分层 ASC;

SELECT 
    asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset
WHERE is_monitored_sector = 1
GROUP BY asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY debt_service_ratio DESC, customer_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND p.customer_segment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code ASC, pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT 
    status AS 卡状态,
    COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = '借记卡'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 卡状态 ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pc.card_id AS 银行卡编号,
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    pe.business_date AS 交易日期,
    pe.amount AS 交易金额
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = '贷记卡结算账户'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ah.party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND ah.holder_role = 'CARDHOLDER'
GROUP BY ah.party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN a.account_subtype = 'credit' THEN '贷记卡'
        WHEN a.account_subtype = 'debit' THEN '借记卡'
    END AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 0
  AND a.account_kind = 'card'
  AND a.account_subtype IN ('credit', 'debit')
GROUP BY a.account_subtype
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, card_type_name ASC;

SELECT 
    channel AS 交易渠道,
    COUNT(*) AS 交易数量,
    AVG(amount) AS 平均金额
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = '已结算' 
  AND is_cash = 0
  AND channel IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY AVG(amount) DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < date('now')
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT collateral_id, asset_label, MAX(pledged_amount) AS highest_value
FROM collateral_asset
JOIN collateral_link ON collateral_asset.collateral_id = collateral_link.collateral_id
GROUP BY collateral_id, asset_label
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY highest_value DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = '有效'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY reference_count DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(g.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(loan_totals.total_disbursed, 2) AS 该合同实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON g.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
) loan_totals ON ca.agreement_id = loan_totals.agreement_id
WHERE g.effective_to IS NULL
  AND g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.guaranteed_amount > loan_totals.total_disbursed
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信合同金额,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(so.covered_amount, 0)), 0) AS 担保覆盖合计,
    ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(so.covered_amount, 0)), 0) AS 保障缺口
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so 
    ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    AND so.effective_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN security_agreement sa 
    ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
    AND sa.status = '有效'
    AND sa.effective_to IS NULL
WHERE ca.status = '有效'
  AND ca.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(so.covered_amount, 0)), 0) > 0
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cg.grade_name_zh,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = '次级'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY cnt DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 贷款余额,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount >= 4
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    rc.grade_code AS classification_name,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provisioned_count,
    SUM(rc.observed_value - rc.amount_value) AS over_provisioned_amount
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN institution i ON rc.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rc.event_code = 'LOAN_IMPAIRMENT_PROVISION'
  AND rc.observed_value > rc.amount_value
GROUP BY i.institution_name, rc.grade_code
ORDER BY over_provisioned_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC, rc.grade_code ASC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_id,
    c.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN va.valuation_type = 'internal' THEN va.valuation_amount END), 2) AS internal_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN va.valuation_type = 'external' THEN va.valuation_amount END), 2) AS external_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN va.valuation_type = 'internal' THEN va.valuation_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN va.valuation_type = 'external' THEN va.valuation_amount END), 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN valuation va ON c.collateral_id = va.collateral_id
WHERE va.valuation_type IN ('internal', 'external')
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN va.valuation_type = 'internal' THEN va.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN va.valuation_type = 'external' THEN va.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN va.valuation_type = 'internal' THEN va.valuation_amount END) > MAX(CASE WHEN va.valuation_type = 'external' THEN va.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 资产名称,
    ROUND(latest_val.latest_value, 2) AS 最新评估价,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0), 2) AS 累计质押额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) - latest_val.latest_value, 2) AS 覆盖缺口
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cl_inner.collateral_id,
        cl_inner.pledged_amount,
        cl_inner.security_id
    FROM collateral_link cl_inner
    WHERE cl_inner.status = '有效'
) cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cl2.collateral_id,
        MAX(cl2.effective_from) AS max_effective_from
    FROM collateral_link cl2
    WHERE cl2.status = '有效'
    GROUP BY cl2.collateral_id
) latest_link ON latest_link.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cl3.collateral_id,
        cl3.pledged_amount AS latest_value
    FROM collateral_link cl3
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            cl4.collateral_id,
            MAX(cl4.effective_from) AS max_eff
        FROM collateral_link cl4
        WHERE cl4.status = '有效'
        GROUP BY cl4.collateral_id
    ) max_eff ON max_eff.collateral_id = cl3.collateral_id AND max_eff.max_eff = cl3.effective_from
    WHERE cl3.status = '有效'
) latest_val ON latest_val.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, latest_val.latest_value
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) > latest_val.latest_value
ORDER BY 覆盖缺口 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_sum.total_loan_amount, 0), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount, 0), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_participant cp ON g.guarantor_party_id = cp.party_id AND cp.participant_role = 'BORROWER'
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON cp.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cp.party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_participant cp
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON cp.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE cp.participant_role = 'BORROWER'
      AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cp.party_id
) loan_sum ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_sum.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND gc.effective_to IS NULL
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) guarantee_sum ON g.guarantor_party_id = guarantee_sum.guarantor_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COALESCE(guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount, 0) > COALESCE(loan_sum.total_loan_amount, 0)
ORDER BY COALESCE(guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount, 0) DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证承诺金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
    AND gc.status = '有效'
WHERE sa.status = '有效'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证承诺金额合计 DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
  AND p.customer_segment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type AS 中文敞口组类型名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员去重数量
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, eg.group_type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 成员去重数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id AS member_party_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, member_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type NOT IN ('非关联方')
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_agreement ca1 WHERE ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id) AS source_loan_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_agreement ca2 WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id) AS target_loan_count
FROM party_relation pr
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca1 WHERE ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca2 WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id)
ORDER BY (source_loan_count + target_loan_count) DESC;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = '有效'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = '有效'
        AND (cl.effective_to IS NULL OR cl.effective_to >= date('now'))
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_principal, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) - COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_principal, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE' 
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
          FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
          WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_exposure ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_exposure.borrower_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, loan_exposure.total_principal
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_principal, 0)
