ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    gp.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON gc.security_id IN (
    SELECT so.security_id 
    FROM secured_obligation so 
    WHERE so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
)
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE gc.guarantor_party_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
    FROM account_holder ah
    JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.loan_account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN payment_instruction pi2 ON pi2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    WHERE pi2.payment_mode = 'PRINCIPAL_OVERDUE'
      AND pi2.status = 'OVERDUE'
)
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.effective_to IS NULL
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gp.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(pr.amount)
        FROM asset_resolution_event pr
        WHERE pr.loan_id = ld.loan_id
          AND pr.event_type = 'REPAYMENT'
    ), 0)), 0) AS overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN party p ON ma.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE wp.product_id IN (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product_holding_snapshot
    WHERE investment_path = 'DIRECT'
)
AND ma.obligor_party_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'OVERDUE'
)
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sc.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(*) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(sc.secured_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM security_agreement sc
WHERE sc.status = '有效'
  AND sc.security_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT so.security_id
      FROM secured_obligation so
      WHERE so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
        AND so.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.status = '有效'
        )
  )
GROUP BY sc.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id AND sa.status = '有效'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = '有效'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = '有效'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = '关联客户型'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY total_inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth AS 嵌套深度,
    phs.carrying_amount AS 持仓账面价值,
    COALESCE(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 0) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  AND wp.issuer_institution_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount, phs.holding_id
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND cl.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_liabilities) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(fs.total_assets), 0), 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL AND fs.total_assets > 0
  AND fs.total_liabilities IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.tier1_capital IS NOT NULL 
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL 
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets != 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets * 1.0 / NULLIF(fs.total_assets, 0), 6) AS net_capital_to_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY net_capital_to_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.annual_revenue AS 营业收入,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue * 100, 2) AS 占比
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        fs2.party_id,
        SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs2
    WHERE fs2.party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
    GROUP BY fs2.party_id
) total_rev ON total_rev.party_id = fs.party_id
WHERE fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM institution i
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id
ORDER BY mismatch_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS 本金合计
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 本金合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.staff_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = '固定雇佣'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') >= 0
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 30
GROUP BY ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 2) AS under_provision_pct
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN provision_snapshot p ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party pt ON pt.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = pt.party_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    rc.grade_code AS risk_classification_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
  AND rc.grade_code IN (SELECT grade_code FROM classification_grade WHERE grade_name LIKE '%不良%')
GROUP BY rc.grade_code
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, risk_classification_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    SUM(l.disbursed_amount) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE l.status = '不良'
  AND julianday('now') - julianday(l.disbursed_on) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id
HAVING SUM(l.disbursed_amount) > 0.5 * fs.annual_revenue
ORDER BY overdue_principal_total DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_percentage
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE' 
  AND ld.closed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_percentage DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode AS 结算方式,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, 结算方式 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pms.record_id) AS exception_record_count,
    SUM(pms.amount_value) AS exception_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pms.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS exception_to_capital_pct
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pms
JOIN institution i ON pms.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = pms.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = pms.institution_id)
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || pms.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || pms.institution_id)
WHERE pms.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY pms.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(pms.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY exception_to_capital_pct DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rsv3.record_id) AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(la.contract_amount), 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement la ON i.institution_id = la.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON la.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
LEFT JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 rsv3 ON i.institution_id = rsv3.institution_id
    AND rsv3.status_code = '逾期未完成'
WHERE ps.loan_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rsv3.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 拨备缺口金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS credit_facility_approval_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.amount_value), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gc.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gc ON i.institution_id = gc.institution_id
WHERE gc.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(gc.record_id) >= 5
ORDER BY governance_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非非关联方关系笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON pr.relation_type = rt.relation_type
WHERE p.party_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE exception_flag = 1
)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS operational_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(ore.record_id) AS operational_risk_valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.status = '有效'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id AND ore.status_code = '有效'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY operational_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(wps.outstanding_balance), 0) AS total_actual_raised_amount,
    COUNT(pr.record_id) AS product_behavior_record_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(pr.observed_value), 0), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id AND wp.status = '在售'
LEFT JOIN wealth_product_snapshot wps ON wp.product_id = wps.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pr ON i.institution_id = pr.institution_id AND pr.exception_flag = 1
WHERE pr.record_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pr.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raised_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS underlying_asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issue_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 0 THEN c.record_id END) AS valid_custody_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN c.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount_total
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN managed_asset ma ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 c ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
WHERE c.status_code = '有效'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issue_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
